messages:
maria: Heads-up — monitoring picked up a 404 on the runtime/kv-cache doc image. Small fix: swap to new CDN path and bump frontmatter last_edited. Assigning if anyone has a minute. /cc @leo @chris
docs-bot: [alert] link-scan detected 404: /docs/runtime/kv-cache#diagram-img — last scanned 2025-03-10
leo: I can take this. Which file exactly?
maria: Path: docs/runtime/kv-cache.md — image at https://cdn-old.example.com/diagrams/kv.png returns 404. Replace with https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/diagrams/kv-cache.png. Also add a one-line note under "Notes" about CDN rehost and set frontmatter `last_edited: 2025-03-10`.
leo: Got it. I'll open a PR. Quick Q: do we need to add a redirect from the old URL or will the relative path rewrite cover it?
chris: Prefer relative path so our static pipeline rewrites to the CDN automatically. No separate redirect needed unless the old URL was externally linked.
leo: Plan: 1) replace absolute URL with relative `/assets/diagrams/kv-cache.png` 2) bump frontmatter 3) run local build and smoke-check 4) open PR with title "docs: runtime kv-cache image rehost". Doing in ~30m.
maria: If you can, add a tiny changelog line in docs/CHANGELOG.md: "2025-03-10 — runtime/kv-cache: image rehost + frontmatter bump — leo"
leo: Will do. Quick local command I'll run: ```bash
mkdocs build && mkdocs serve --dev-addr=127.0.0.1:8000
# then check /site/docs/runtime/kv-cache/index.html to confirm image loads
```
chris: Nice. Ping me when PR is up; I'll do a quick review. Also check CI preview for the image asset.
leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 — title "docs: runtime kv-cache image rehost". Marked as smallfix and added changelog entry.
chris: Reviewing now. One nit: use the relative path and avoid query params. Also can you add a 1-sentence note in the doc "Images rehosted to our CDN to resolve 404s" so searchers see it in commit history?
leo: Updated PR with relative path and added the note. Rebuilt locally, image shows correctly.
docs-bot: Deploy preview ready — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/8421 — image loads and page returns 200.
maria: Awesome, thanks all. I'll merge after chris gives final LG. :rocket:
